outcome: duration of ART/pARV prior to delivery (specifically whether it was ≤ 8 weeks)
cohort: 670 ART-naive HIV-positive women enrolled in a Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission (PMTCT) program in Central Women Hospital, Mandalay, Myanmar, between March 2011 and December 2016.
finding: The study found a high uptake of ART/pARV among enrolled HIV-positive pregnant women, but approximately 12% did not receive ART before delivery, and nearly half of those who did initiate ART before delivery received it for less than 8 weeks.
